name: Fluent Support

evidence.helpdesk: F02: Self-hosted WordPress help desk with a customer ticket portal; F17: email piping creates tickets on Pro
evidence.inbox: F18: Agents share the inbox with assignment, permissions and internal notes on Free; email piping adds Pro (F17)

line: WordPress ticketing and support portal with email piping on paid plans.

free.text: Free plugin: unlimited agents and tickets

cells.channels: Web portal, email piping, Slack, WhatsApp
cells.ai: Own provider costs; per-answer rate unknown

agents.math: The annual email plan, at its first-year price, includes ten piping addresses (addresses that create tickets from email) and unlimited agents.
One site license covers three agents, on the annual first-year email plan.
